name: Old City Street Food Run
description: A dawn-to-dusk crawl through the lanes around Charminar — breakfast dosa, Irani chai, benchmark biryani, and a malai finish.

stops.note: Start at dawn: butter dosa hot off the tawa.
Irani chai and Osmania biscuits as the Charminar crowd builds.
Biryani lunch under the mirror ceilings.
Cross the river to finish: fruit and malai.
